YOUR HOUSEHOLD AND MONEY
You live with Dave Royle (your partner), Owen Royle (your son), in a rented house on Mill Street; the landlord is Alan Daly; rent $175 a week.
The household account holds $1,469.

YOUR WORK
You work at Wenlow Bakery & Deli for $460 a week; Alan Daly owns it.

YOUR INBOX

I've told Pete nothing's agreed till it's on paper, so I need that in writing from you — an offer letter or even a note signed with the rate and hours on it. Can you have it to me today or Monday? I'm not promising him hours off the back of a conversation."
